title: RESIST: Resilient Decentralized Learning Using Consensus Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2502.07977v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Empirical risk minimization (ERM) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. This paper focuses on the man-in-the-middle (MITM) attack, wherein adversaries exploit communication vulnerabilities between devices to inject malicious updates during training. To address this challenge, we propose RESIST (Resilient dEcentralized learning using conSensus gradIent deScenT), an optimization algorithm designed to be robust against adversarially compromised communication links. RESIST uses a multistep consensus gradient descent framework with robust-statistics-based screening of neighbor messages. It has a design parameter $J$ that controls the frequency of local gradient computation: each local gradient update is preceded by $J-1$ communication and robust aggregation rounds. translated_title: RESIST：基于共识梯度下降的弹性去中心化学习
translated_abstract: 经验风险最小化（ERM）是现代机器学习的基石。本文关注中间人（MITM）攻击，即攻击者利用设备之间的通信漏洞在训练过程中注入恶意更新。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了RESIST（基于共识梯度下降的弹性去中心化学习），这是一种旨在抵御被对抗性破坏的通信链路的优化算法。RESIST采用多步共识梯度下降框架，并基于鲁棒统计对邻居消息进行筛选。该算法有一个设计参数J，用于控制本地梯度计算的频率：每次本地梯度更新之前会进行J-1轮通信和鲁棒聚合。与在每次迭代中同时执行通信和本地梯度更新的方法相比，当J>2时，RESIST在相同的通信量下使用更少的本地梯度更新。
tldr: 提出RESIST算法，通过多步共识梯度下降框架和基于鲁棒统计的邻居消息筛选机制，有效抵御去中心化学习中的中间人攻击，并在相同通信量下减少本地梯度更新次数。
